        d_max = np.max(distances)

        if d_max <= 0:
            return -np.inf
        return -d_min / d_max

        y = 1 - (i / 6.5)  # map i to [-1, 1]

        initial_points[i, 2] = y

    initial_points += np.random.normal(0, 0.03, (14, 3))

    bounds = [(-0.95, 0.95) for _ in range(14 * 3)]

    result = differential_evolution(
        objective, 
        bounds, 
        maxiter=200,  # Increased iterations for better convergence
        popsize=25,   # Larger population for better exploration
        seed=42,
        strategy='best1bin',
        recombination=0.9,  # Higher recombination rate for better mixing
        atol=1e-9,  # Tighter absolute tolerance

    )
